orgDescription: Humanoid robot hire with an operator for events, brand activations and marketing in Monaco and across the French Riviera, plus custom robot software and AI assistant builds.
tagline: Monaco and the French Riviera · reply within 24 hours

branding.p: A plate on the chest, about 17 by 10 cm, and an A3 board on the back: both carry your artwork. One robot here shows the front, the other the back; drag to walk around them. We print and fit it before the doors open, so the robot walks in already wearing your campaign.
branding.alt: Two humanoid robots in 3D side by side, one from the front showing a logo plate on its chest, one from behind showing an A3 advertising board on its back

priceNote: Multi-day rate, excluding VAT. Single days quoted on request.
